body: Fixed the reproduced delayed-watcher notification bug: refresh now checks current registration under the workspace gate and cleans absent-project projections instead of recreating PROJECT_UNAVAILABLE. The 473-test full gate, 16 focused deletion/recovery tests and all 16 release Chromium deletion scenarios pass. WebKit suite startup remains blocked by unsupported clipboard-write permission. Rebuilt/restarted the existing manual app; trusted HTTPS verifies 32 assets, diagnostics is ready with zero source issues, and 22 remaining resource versions, pin, preferences, certificate and instance/epoch are preserved. Two concurrent owner card deletions committed before restart are accounted for. Evidence: progress/2026-10-03-deleted-project-diagnostics.md. This resolves the issue described in report bfae0ade-b65d-49b3-9397-c9bb6aecd052; release acceptance remains open.

metadata.summary: Deleted-project source diagnostics fixed and verified
